encounters.title: The Factor at the Water Station
encounters.description: Two wagons stand in the lee of the water station, tarped against the ash. The factor works through her ledger by memory: medicine, axle parts, the crossing she lost. Her prices are fast and exact, and she mentions once, without emphasis, that she pays favors back with interest.

choices.text: Trade fair — medicine and axle parts at her asking price.
Buy her shortage at a premium she is in no position to refuse.

encounters.title: Wreckage on the Cut Road
encounters.description: A wagon sits hip-deep in a collapsed cut road crust, harness still on. The factor who owns it is camped on the wreck with a rifle across her knees, guarding cargo she cannot move. She looks up at your column and starts naming prices before you are close enough to see her face clearly.

choices.text: Spend the water and the day — pull the wagon out and walk her people in.
Take what is loose on the wreck and leave the road its due.
